title: Uniformisation of complete Kähler surfaces with positive sectional curvature
summary: We prove that any complete non-compact Kähler surface with positive sectional curvature is biholomorphic to $\mathbb{C}^2$, establishing the two dimensional case of the weaker form of Yau's uniformisation conjecture. In contrast to all previous results, no assumptions are made on the geometry at infinity. The proof introduces a new approach towards Yau-type uniformisation problems, based on uniformly Lipschitz plurisubharmonic weight functions with finite Monge-Ampère mass, and weighted $L^p$ holomorphic functions.
